FormTransform.op: Keep the rows where the field
FormTransform.pattern: Pattern (a regular expression with one group)

kind.extract: Take a part of a field

Transform.field: filter: the field compared. Not read by the operation param.
Transform.value: filter: what the field is compared with; for oneOf a comma-separated list, for range two comma-separated bounds. Numbers are read as numbers.
Transform.param: filter: the selection whose content passes, for the operation param.
Transform.fields: fold: the fields to fold - each becomes a row with the field name as key and its value as value, so several columns become one series per column.
Transform.keyAs: fold: the name of the new field holding the former column name.
Transform.valueAs: fold: the name of the new field holding the value.
Transform.as: calculate: the name of the new field.
Transform.expression: calculate: the Vega expression, for example datum.price * datum.amount; datum is the row. Expressions are interpreted, never compiled to code.
Transform.pattern: extract: what the group of this expression matches in the field becomes the new field, e.g. ^(\S+) for the first word.

ColumnType.type: What its values are read as.
ColumnType.unit: The unit of a number, e.g. m or cm.
ColumnType.label: How the column is called where it is shown. Empty: its name.
